upstream.notes: Linked from Hugging Face once a model is chosen. Deliberate releases only: a model swap changes answer quality for every user, so it is never automatic.

notes: No model chosen (spec: Open questions). What has to be settled before this entry stops being a placeholder: which open-weight 1-4B instruction model; whether its licence allows redistribution and app use at all (several 'open' licences do not); the quantisation (a Q4_K_M GGUF of a 3B model is roughly 2 GB, which matches the spec's 2.4 GB budget); and where the precomputed embeddings live -- they are per-pack, so they probably belong in each hfdb rather than in this pack. Hugging Face resolve URLs are stable per revision; pin the revision sha in the url, never 'main'.
